title: How Forward Deployed Engineering is done at Ramp — Leo Mehr
talk_summary: Leo Mehr describes Ramp's Forward Deployed Engineering org, arguing two principles matter most: rigorously scoping requests before building, and replacing each stage of the FDE lifecycle with agents. He gives one concrete example—a Notion-based intake agent that does multi-round clarifying questions before producing a spec—and claims ~20% time savings on scoping.

takeaways.what_they_do: A Slack/Notion intake agent takes raw, high-variance requests and runs several rounds of back-and-forth questions with the submitter until it deems the request ready to emit a spec.
takeaways.numbers: claims ~20% of scoping time saved; reply latency from hours/days to seconds

takeaways.technique: Decompose the lifecycle into per-stage agents rather than one monolith
takeaways.what_they_do: They map the FDE pipeline (context gathering → scoping → spec → implementation) and build a separate agent for each stage, treating the middle 'spec' stage as the hard, unformed part.
takeaways.evidence_quote: each stage of that pipeline can be replaced with agents

takeaways.technique: Per-stage output quality gates with rubrics and human feedback
takeaways.what_they_do: They plan to verify each pipeline stage's output quality using evals, rubrics, and human feedback rather than only checking the final product.

takeaways.technique: Codify tacit product knowledge as agent context (skills/memories/tools)
takeaways.what_they_do: They flag that docs and help articles only capture part of what a PM knows, and that getting that tacit product context into the agent (skills, memories, tools) is the biggest challenge.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Imagine like all the knowledge that a product manager has in their head about their product. Like, how do you get that into an agent?

takeaways.technique: Scope-before-build discipline (validate assumptions, check pipeline reuse)
takeaways.what_they_do: Before building, FDEs interrogate urgency, users, workarounds, and whether other prospects need the same thing—citing a case where they built Android for a customer that mandated iOS.
takeaways.evidence_quote: they mandate all of their employees to use iOS devices
